description: A nursing supervisor must assign the hospital's one available overnight constant-observation aide between two inpatient units and finalize the supervision plan for the unit that does not receive the aide, with input from nursing, social work, occupational therapy, and staffing.

shared_context.S1: One overnight constant-observation aide is available for assignment from 21:00 tonight until 07:00 tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: The aide can cover only one of the East Unit or West Unit.
shared_context.S3: Both units have patients whose overnight supervision needs are being reviewed.
shared_context.S4: Marisol makes the binding assignment and approves the alternate safety plan for the unit without the aide.
shared_context.S5: The hospital's overnight safety-huddle routine requires Marisol to check with the involved unit nurse, social work, occupational therapy, and staffing before finalizing coverage.

PF1.text: The East Unit patient made a recent attempt to leave the unit and currently requires continuous direct observation overnight; hourly rounding alone does not meet the patient's safety order.

PF2.text: The West Unit patient's son has confirmed that he will remain at the bedside from exactly 22:00 through 06:00 tonight and can immediately alert nursing to any concern.

PF3.text: The West Unit patient completed an occupational-therapy assessment showing safe call-bell use and supervised bathroom transfers; an every-two-hour nursing round is the specified overnight backup plan.

PF4.text: A functioning video-monitoring station is available for the West Unit tonight, and staffing can install and test it by exactly 21:00 if it is included in the coverage plan.

acceptance_conditions: The constant-observation aide must be assigned to the East Unit.
The West Unit plan must document the son's bedside support from exactly 22:00 through 06:00.
The West Unit must have nursing rounds every two hours.
Video monitoring must be enabled for the West Unit and ready by exactly 21:00.
The East Unit's observation requirement must be explicitly cited as justification for assigning the aide there.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The East patient's attempted departure and direct-observation order change the aide assignment from an unresolved choice to the East Unit and require that fact to support the justification.
The son's exact 22:00-to-06:00 availability changes the West plan from unspecified support to documented family support with a 22:00 start and 06:00 end.
The occupational-therapy assessment changes the West backup plan from unspecified observation to a nursing-round interval of exactly 2 hours.
The confirmed station and installation deadline change the West plan from no specified electronic monitoring to video monitoring enabled and ready by exactly 21:00.
